input.value: rear-end collision at red light on Route 9
totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat

input.rationale: This is a motor-vehicle collision resulting in a totaled vehicle and injury to the policyholder; it falls clearly under auto coverage.

Vehicle is totaled (exceeds typical $25k threshold), and the policyholder has sustained injuries (whiplash and sprained wrist), plus pending potential complications; this warrants immediate adjuster attention and possible medical follow-up.

input.claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 at 8:15 AM yesterday by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking; the car is totaled with the trunk crushed into the back seat. The claimant has sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. The other driver's insurance information is available on the police report.
